cuts.placeText: a landscaping yard — stacked rocks, a wheelbarrow, gravel piles and a half-finished stone garden path
cuts.scene: she is a landscaper standing with her hands folded beside the half-finished stone path, studying the next stretch
cuts.outfit: a landscaper look fitted to her body — a short-sleeved work shirt tied at the waist and short work shorts with boots and gloves, bare legs, a stone-gray tool pouch
